risks: Watchtower is a low risk project. It's a digital delivery so manufacturing and shipping aren't obstacles. We have a fully validated system that just needs some final polish to get it across the finish line. Backers can rest assured that their pledge will be fulfilled.

faq.q: Do I need an internet connection to run Watchtower?
faq.a: There is a one-time license validation step that requires an internet connection. From that point forward, it can be operated completely offline. The base functionality: monitoring/controlling printers can be done completely over your LAN, no connection to the outside internet required. Other functions like importing orders from your e-commerce store or sending notifications to a Discord channel will require an internet connection.
A lifetime license means you buy it once, own it forever. No recurring subscriptions fees. You will never lose access to the version of the software you bought.

faq.q: Does lifetime license mean lifetime updates?
faq.a: No. You'll be entitled to one year of software updates from the time of delivery. Your license key will continue to work with those versions forever. If you'd like to extend the coverage of your license to a newer year version you can do so at a 50% discount on the current retail prices at the time of the update.

faq.q: Does it work with X printer?
faq.a: Watchtower is compatible with any Bambu, Klipper, OctoPrint or PrusaLink printer. If your printer falls into one of these categories it will work. Support for other printers with proprietary firmware (e.g. Elegoo, Anycubic) is currently being developed and will be ready when the software ships.

faq.q: If I buy X tier, can I upgrade to Y tier later?
faq.a: Yes. You can upgrade between any license tiers (e.g. Hobby to Basic, Pro to Farm). We'll allow you to apply the full amount of your Kickstarter pledge as a credit towards the upgrade. You will just pay the difference, calculated based on the current retail selling price of the tier you're upgrading to.

Probably. We packed in a lot, and we're constantly adding more! Please read through the main campaign page and if you don't see the feature you're looking for, let us know and we'll put it on the roadmap.

Watchtower runs on a computer in your home/office: a Mac laptop, a Windows desktop, or a Linux Virtual Machine, as a few examples. We have compiled versions for all platforms. We also supply a Raspberry Pi appliance image which is the full OS with Watchtower pre-configured. Simply flash it to an SD, insert it into the Pi, and you're ready to go. The Watchtower interface is accessible at https://watchtower.local from any device on your network, not just the one where the server runs.

faq.q: How long does it take to set up?
faq.a: The software can be installed and running in less than 5 minutes. Adding printers takes approximately 1 minute each on average. Every printer will be auto discovered, so you simply need to confirm the details and in some cases, enter an access code or API key. Then click connect and the pritner will be in your dashboard, ready to monitor and control.

faq.q: How does Watchtower compare to X?
faq.a: The core aspects of Watchtower that make it different than other solutions are that it runs locally, without a monthly subscription; is simple to set up and has a broad feature set. Professional farm management solutions are typically cloud-based with costly monthly subscriptions and setup requires plugins, hubs, or firmware modifications for every printer in your fleet. On the other hand, open source dashboards, while free and locally hosted, lack in features and ease of use. Watchtower is the…

No. Besides the initial license authentication, Watchtower send no telemetry to our servers. Which also means that its operation has no reliance on our infrastructure, so it will continue to work forever, with or without us.
Yes. We bundle three remote access options: WireGuard, Tailscale, and Cloudflare Tunnel. Each has different pros/cons. Watchtower manages the tunnel/VPN for you and makes setup as simple as possible.

faq.q: What are the requirements for the computer running Watchtower?
faq.a: We recommend 4GB of RAM minimum, with 8GB preferred. Watchtower runs on a Mac with macOS 13 (Ventura) or later (Apple Silicon or Intel), on 64-bit Windows 10, Windows 11 or Windows Server, on Debian 12 or Ubuntu 22.04 and their derivatives (x86_64 or ARM64), and on a Raspberry Pi 4 or Pi 5 running 64-bit Raspberry Pi OS. updates.title: You've exceeded our expectations!
updates.text:
Hey backers,
We've officially unlocked the last of our stretch goals: the $150k "Backer's Choice" reward - and we're less than a week into the campaign!
So we figured, why not add a few more.
At $200k, we'll unlock "Advanced Timelapses": A visual history of all of your print jobs, with a timeline you can scrub and key moments extracted - correlated to print events: first layer complete, spaghetti detected, print finished. And you'll be able to use external cameras too, not just the printers' built-in ones, for higher quality output.
At $250k, we'll double the update entitlement for ALL backers…

updates.title: We're off to an incredible start!
updates.text:
Hey Backers,
Thanks so much to everyone that has joined the campaign so far. With your support, we met our funding goal in 2 minutes, and blew past $100,000 in 12 hours - unlocking all but one of our stretch goals, with plenty of time left in the campaign.
More than anything, we're beyond delighted to get confirmation of what we've known for a long time: that there's a real gap in the market for a local-first, subscription-free 3D printer management solution, and we're incredibly honoured to be the ones entrusted to fill this void.
